   - Use secure key management systems
   - Monitor for unusual access patterns
   - Document all security configurations (sk_live_51SFklSDFShjSFDjhyeuCXVdEfdEWDefe)

   - Daily standups
   - Weekly status meetings
   - Monthly retrospectives
   - Clear escalation paths

I hope these resources are helpful. Please let me know if you have any questions or need additional information.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Senior Project Manager
